overall_limits: Model, scenarios and outputs share one informed author with canon and variant knowledge.
First responses are actually authored after the bound inputs but not generated by a separate runtime or blind judge.
Generic-role and near-canonical rivals remain; plausible wording is not model identification.
English prose with a few forms of address is not demonstrated Japanese comic timing, natural acoustic voice or native-human adequacy.
Observed action, proposed next act, response and completed consequence stay separate.
All original first bodies, including weak or defective details, remain exact.
tier_boundary: The distinct source-grounded conditional model can be a scoped Tier3 candidate; these internal outputs establish no operational reliability or grade and do not close the broader program.
